note: ⛔ SNG-486. Ki Wield — Body's capstone, and the first Body craft to name the tradition's own power source.

abilities.name: Ki Wield
abilities.narrationHints: Nothing is drawn and nothing is worn. The air around the hands goes hard and slightly wrong, the way heat does over stone, and then a man in full plate is on his back with a hole in it.
abilities.description: Draw the body's own force out past the skin and wear it — as edge, as bolt, as armour — and it goes through what stops steel.
abilities.notFor: Anyone who has not mastered their own body; being worn while unconscious; anything you do not have the breath left to hold.

bounds.text: ⛔ IT COSTS BREATH CONTINUOUSLY. Energy drains each round it is held, and when it runs out it drops mid-exchange
⚠️ THE WIELDER IS THE SOURCE — a body already spent has nothing to draw
one form at a time: edge, bolt, or armour. Changing form costs the action
it pierces RESISTANCE, not distance — a wall is still a wall

abilities.plainly: A fight/duel action that deals damage. It rolls 4d6. Ranks: rank 2 fires it at range, rank 3 wears it as armour and holds all three at once.

sectFlavour.somatic: THE PERFECTED VESSEL SPENDING ITSELF — what the Flesh-Temples train toward and rarely reach.
sectFlavour.mason: ⚠️ Not this craft. A mason picks up something heavy.

tree.name: Ki Edge
tree.grants: ⛔ ARM YOURSELF IN KI. Hands, feet or a held weapon carry the body's force past the skin — and it PIERCES RESISTANCE: armour, hide, soak and craft-resistances all count for far less against it.
tree.cannot: Contact range. It costs breath every round it is held.

tree.name: Ki Bolt
tree.grants: ⚠️ ADDS RANGE. Throw it — a bolt of the same force, loosed from an open hand, arriving as hard as the strike and piercing the same way.
tree.cannot: One bolt per action, and each one costs more breath than a strike.

tree.name: Ki Wield
tree.grants: ⛔ ADDS ARMOUR AND SIMULTANEITY. Wear it as well — force held at the skin that turns blows and crafts alike — and hold edge, bolt and armour AT ONCE rather than choosing.
tree.cannot: ⛔ The drain triples while all three are held. A body that runs out while armoured is a body with nothing left.

abilities._authored:
⛔ SNG-486. Erik: 'I'm not feeling Pathless Way — cut. A BODY CAPSTONE SHOULD BE KI WIELD or something — ARM AND ARMOR YOURSELF IN KI. It PIERCES RESISTANCES, can be FIRED LIKE MAGIC BOLTS and can SHIELD you.'
⚠️ IT ALSO ANSWERS SOMETHING THE AUDIT FOUND: metaphysical is Body's power source — 'Veil/Psychic/KI type innate power' (SNG-445) — and NOT ONE BODY CRAFT NAMED KI. The tradition's own source was invisible in its own skill list.
⛔ AND IT IS THE COUNTER TO SHAPED BODY r3, which grants resistance to crafts. Ki Wield pierces resistance. The tradition now contains its own answer.
